newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Buba's Issing says may look at 2-yr period for M3.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Issing says may look at 2-yr period for M3.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Otmar Issing said on Friday the German Bunbdesbank might look at a time period of two-years when deciding on its next target growth rate for money supply
"The situation in this year is special because of the planned start of EMU at the start of 1999. We will look at those two years together," he told reporters. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
